comment: DO NOT TAKE IT! She is a tough grader and irresponsible for her class. Although she seems really nice, she doesn't have an idea of what a good class looks like. She gives a huge amount of work for us to do without giving any rubric for grading. Then, you receive a B for no reason. She doesn't care if we know art or not.

She was probably the worst professor Ive ever had at UR. She assigns huge projects and expects you to do everything outside of class time. She forgets that this is a gen. ed. class. There are extra lab hours every week that arent specified when you register, on top of the work outside of class. This was the worst class and professor. DO NOT TAKE.

I originally took this class to fill my gen ed art credit, looking back I would not recommend taking this! First of all there is a required 2 hour lab that isn't mentioned in the class description. Though she herself was nice she was constantly assigning projects that required materials that could only be obtained by traveling off campus.
